ORDER MATTERS: r09 is the NINTH region of the fabulae track and must sit
after r08 and before r10 in the manifest's regions array — js/app.js
regionIndex() reads that order and feeds it to the phase engine as the ONE
difficulty input (DESIGN §6). Apply r07, then r08, then r09, then r10.
Regiō IX · Castra is a WOLF region. CURRICULUM §1 gives the same Lupus the
bosses of R1, R5, R9 and the R12 finale, so this block mirrors r05's rather
than r06/r07/r08's: hp 8 over 74 phase-seconds (24 caterva + 30 clamor + 20
fuga) against r05's 72, and short of the r10 block the parallel author
already shipped at hp 8 / 78. The extra seconds are all in CLAMOR, which is
where this region's syntax lives. Legacy single-phase tuning in the content
file is hp 8 / 52 s, kept because rules.php reads it and because a client
without js/boss-phases.js must still be able to fight.
bossMinMs 15000 — the same floor every duel region uses (region1, r02-r08,
r10). The fight is LONGER than r08's, and a longer fight cannot be forged
FASTER: the phase seconds are ceilings, not durations, so the floor does
not move. This is the reasoning rules.php already records against r05.
XP mirrors the fabulae track exactly: step 20 is the global default
(RULE_DEFAULT_STEP_XP) and is listed here only so the value is visible;
fight 30 and quizEach 10 with quizPassMaxWrong 1 are what r01-r08 use.
quizKey carries the same {q, a} pair per row that r03-r08 use: rules.php
stores the question word and the vocab key that must be picked, so grading
never depends on the order the client drew the options in. For a word ->
pick-the-image quiz the answer IS the question word, and `correct` is
always 0 against the boss.quiz order in content/fabulae-r09.js.
